title: Privileged View
summary:
One of the rarer views of the skyline from across Toronto Harbour is from the Royal Canadian Yacht Club, where the wooden plank docks and the High Performance Sailing Centre (the older building to the left) are visual reminders of bygone days. The ever taller and more crowded horizon behind it all, however, tells you without a doubt that this is 2026.
